name: VIS
recent: Visdynamics 在 2026 年 9 月底公布截至 7 月底的季度业绩，营收与净利大幅增长，净利率升至 30.5%。随后多名董事与主要官员在 10 月密集交易公司凭单 C 2023/2028 及部分普通股，并在 11 月初行使雇员认股期权（ESOS），公司因此发行 142.6 万股新股。
notable: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度净利达 376.4 万令吉，净利率 30.5%。
董事与主要官员在 10 月多次交易凭单 C 2023/2028 及普通股。
雇员认股期权行使后，公司于 11 月 3 日上市 142.6 万股新股。
risks: 多名董事与主要官员在 10 月出售凭单及部分普通股。
雇员认股期权行使导致新股发行，现有股东持股可能被稀释。
earnings: 2026 财年截至 7 月 31 日季度营收 1235.4 万令吉，环比增长 91.1%，同比增长 57.5%；净利 376.4 万令吉，环比增长 496.5%，同比增长 294.5%；净利率从上一季的 9.8% 升至 30.5%。

recent_en: Visdynamics reported quarterly results for the period ended July 2026 in late September, with revenue and net profit rising sharply and net margin reaching 30.5%. In October, several directors and principal officers actively traded the company's Warrants C 2023/2028 and some ordinary shares, and in early November they exercised ESOS options, resulting in the issuance of 1.426 million new shares.
notable_en: Net profit for the quarter ended 31 July 2026 reached RM3.764 million, with a net margin of 30.5%.
Directors and principal officers traded Warrants C 2023/2028 and ordinary shares multiple times in October.
Following the exercise of ESOS options, 1.426 million new shares were listed on 3 November.
risks_en: Several directors and principal officers sold warrants and some ordinary shares in October.
The exercise of ESOS options resulted in the issuance of new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM12.354 million, up 91.1% QoQ and 57.5% YoY; net profit was RM3.764 million, up 496.5% QoQ and 294.5% YoY; net margin rose to 30.5% from 9.8% in the previous quarter.
